# ===================================================================== # helpdesk.ticket — Auto-suscripción de seguidores (responsable + proveedor) # + avisos al manager cuando el responsable no se puede notificar. # # - Responsable (hr.employee): partner por usuario vinculado # (user_id.partner_id) y, si NO tiene usuario, por el contacto de # trabajo (work_contact_id). Se suscribe como seguidor. # - Proveedor (res.partner): se suscribe como seguidor. # - Aviso WARN_EMAIL: responsable sin work_email. # - Aviso WARN_NOPARTNER: responsable sin usuario NI contacto de trabajo # (no se puede suscribir); pide al manager rellenarlo. # Ambos avisos son idempotentes por empleado mediante marcador (EMP:<id>). # # Producción: silencioso en éxito, registra solo errores. # ===================================================================== # --- Constantes --- NOTE_SUBTYPE = 'mail.mt_note' # Nota interna, sin email SAVEPOINT_NAME = 'subscribe_followers' # Aísla fallos por registro
WARN_EMAIL = ("The responsible user %s doesn't have a Work email. Please add the " "email to the employee and then set the responsible again. (EMP:%s)")
WARN_NOPARTNER = ("The responsible %s can't be added as a follower because the " "employee has no linked user and no Work Contact set. Please " "fill in the Work Contact (or link a user) on the employee, " "then set the responsible again. (EMP-NC:%s)")
for record in records: # 1) Partners objetivo (sin duplicar). target_ids = []
employee = record.x_studio_responsable if employee: marker_email = "(EMP:%s)" % employee.id marker_nc = "(EMP-NC:%s)" % employee.id # Cache de los cuerpos de mensaje: se reutiliza para ambos avisos. bodies = record.message_ids.mapped("body")
# 1a) Aviso si el responsable no tiene correo de trabajo. if not employee.work_email: already_warned = False for body in bodies: if body and marker_email in body: already_warned = True break if not already_warned: record.message_post( body=WARN_EMAIL % (employee.display_name, employee.id), subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE, )
# 1b) Responsable -> partner. Preferimos el del usuario vinculado; # si el empleado NO tiene usuario, usamos el contacto de trabajo. resp_partner = employee.user_id.partner_id if not resp_partner: resp_partner = employee.work_contact_id
if resp_partner: if resp_partner.id not in target_ids: target_ids.append(resp_partner.id) else: # 1c) Sin usuario NI contacto de trabajo: no se puede suscribir. # Avisamos al manager (idempotente por empleado). already_warned_nc = False for body in bodies: if body and marker_nc in body: already_warned_nc = True break if not already_warned_nc: record.message_post( body=WARN_NOPARTNER % (employee.display_name, employee.id), subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE, )
# Proveedor (res.partner) directo. supplier = record.x_studio_supplier if supplier and supplier.id not in target_ids: target_ids.append(supplier.id)
if not target_ids: continue
# 2) Guard de idempotencia: descartar los que ya son seguidores. current_ids = record.message_partner_ids.ids to_add = [] for pid in target_ids: if pid not in current_ids: to_add.append(pid) if not to_add: continue
# 3) Suscripción aislada por savepoint (constraint único de mail.followers). env.cr.execute('SAVEPOINT %s' % SAVEPOINT_NAME) try: record.message_subscribe(partner_ids=to_add) env.cr.execute('RELEASE SAVEPOINT %s' % SAVEPOINT_NAME) except Exception as e: env.cr.execute('ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT %s' % SAVEPOINT_NAME) record.message_post( body="Error al suscribir seguidores %s: %s" % (to_add, e), subtype_xmlid=NOTE_SUBTYPE, )

if record.x_studio_intervention_date and not record.x_studio_maintenance_request_id:
tag_names = ", ".join(record.tag_ids.mapped("name")) if record.tag_ids else "Sin tags" priority = record.x_studio_priority or "Sin prioridad"
maintenance_name = "%s - %s" % (tag_names, priority)
responsible_user = False
if record.x_studio_pdv: responsible_user = env["res.users"].sudo().search([ ("pos_config_ids", "in", [record.x_studio_pdv.id]) ], limit=1)
maintenance_request = env["maintenance.request"].sudo().create({ "name": maintenance_name, "schedule_date": record.x_studio_intervention_date,
# Notas del mantenimiento "description": record.x_studio_incidencia_detectada or "",
# Ticket de origen "x_studio_ticket_origin": record.id,
# PDV / POS Config "x_studio_pdv": record.x_studio_pdv.id if record.x_studio_pdv else False,
# Responsable de mantenimiento "user_id": responsible_user.id if responsible_user else False, })
record.sudo().write({ "x_studio_maintenance_request_id": [(4, maintenance_request.id)] })
